findings.en_sentence: Based on a larger dentary bone, researchers proposed that Giganotosaurus had a skull up to 1.95 meters long, though extrapolations from a related species suggest a length of 1.634 meters, and after finding another jawbone, the skull length was re-estimated at 1.8 meters, making it the carnivorous dinosaur with the largest known skull.
findings.problem: Wrong chronology and outdated conclusion: 1.80 m was Calvo & Coria's 1998 estimate for the holotype (same paper as the 1.95 m for the larger dentary), not a later re-estimate after the 2022 1.634 m figure; the 1.80 m reconstruction is considered too long (Therrien & Henderson 2007: 1.56 m; Carrano et al. 2012: same size as Tyrannosaurus), so 'the carnivorous dinosaur with the largest known skull' is not current.
findings.correct: In 1998 Calvo and Coria estimated the holotype skull at 1.80 m and the larger dentary's individual at 1.95 m; later studies gave shorter figures (1.56 m in 2007, 1.634 m in 2022), so it had one of the largest known theropod skulls, not unquestionably the largest.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Discovery / Continued size estimations (F017, F024, F026); eswiki F086, F108

findings.en_sentence: Coria suggested that a bonebed of Mapusaurus, a close relative of Giganotosaurus, was the result of a catastrophic event and that the mix of ages indicated these large theropods hunted in packs.
findings.es_sentence: Coria sugirió que un yacimiento con huesos de Mapusaurus, pariente cercano de Giganotosaurus, fue el resultado de un evento catastrófico y que la mezcla de edades indicaba que estos grandes terópodos cazaban en manada.
findings.problem: Coria's argument was that the bonebed held mainly medium-sized individuals with very few young or old, as is normal for pack animals; 'the mix of ages' inverts it, and the source says large theropods 'may have' hunted in groups.
findings.correct: Coria suggested that a bonebed of Mapusaurus ... was the result of a catastrophic event, and that its mostly medium-sized individuals, with very few young or old, fit animals living in packs, so these large theropods may have hunted in groups. / ...y que el predominio de individuos de tamaño medio, con muy pocos jóvenes o viejos, es típico de animales que forman manadas, por lo que estos grandes terópodos quizá cazaban en grupo.

findings.en_sentence: The jaw articulated far behind the neck attachment point compared to other theropods, and the curvature of the lower jaw indicates that Giganotosaurus had a wide mouth, allowing it to close its jaws quickly to capture and bring down prey with powerful bites.
findings.es_sentence: La mandíbula se articulaba mucho más atrás del punto de inserción del cuello que en otros terópodos, y la curvatura de la mandíbula inferior indica que el Giganotosaurus tenía una boca ancha, capaz de cerrar las fauces rápidamente para capturar y abatir presas con mordidas potentes.
findings.problem: The quick jaw closure is linked to the wide mouth; in the source it comes from the jaw joint being moved backwards (longer jaw muscles), and the powerful bites from Therrien et al. 2005, not from mouth width.
findings.correct: The jaw joint sat far behind the neck attachment, lengthening the jaw muscles so the jaws could close quickly; the lower jaw's curve shows the mouth was wide. / La articulación mandibular estaba muy retrasada respecto al cóndilo occipital, lo que alargaba los músculos y permitía cerrar las fauces rápidamente; la curva del dentario indica una boca ancha.
findings.checked_in: enwiki Feeding (Coria & Currie 2002; Therrien et al. 2005), Skull (F055, F056)

findings.en_sentence: Giganotosaurus was likely the largest predator of its time, occupying the top of the food chain.
findings.es_sentence: El Giganotosaurus fue probablemente el depredador más grande de su época, ocupando la cima de la cadena trófica.
findings.problem: 'Largest predator of its time' is not supported: enwiki only says it was the apex predator of its ecosystem, and broadly contemporary carcharodontosaurids and spinosaurids (e.g. Carcharodontosaurus, Spinosaurus) were as large or larger.
findings.correct: Giganotosaurus was probably the apex predator of its ecosystem. / El Giganotosaurus fue probablemente el superdepredador de su ecosistema.

findings.en_sentence: The holotype specimen has been estimated to be between 12 and 13 meters long, while other studies based on the same skeleton suggest a weight of 6.1 to 6.9 tons and a height of over 4 meters at the hips.
findings.es_sentence: El ejemplar holotipo se estima que midió entre 12 y 13 metros de longitud, mientras que otros estudios basados en el mismo esqueleto sugieren un peso de 6,1 a 6,9 toneladas y una altura superior a 4 metros en la cadera.
findings.problem: 6.1-6.9 t is presented as the weight estimate, but published estimates for the holotype range from 4.2 to 13.8 t (and the page itself later cites 8-10 t).
findings.correct: ...while weight estimates for the same skeleton vary widely, from about 4.2 to 13.8 tons (most around 6-8 tons)...

findings.en_sentence: Researchers concluded that Giganotosaurus reached the maximum possible size for a strictly bipedal animal.
findings.es_sentence: Los investigadores concluyeron que el Giganotosaurus alcanzaba el tamaño máximo posible para un animal estrictamente bípedo.
findings.problem: This is one study's conclusion (Therrien & Henderson 2007) about the largest theropods in general (Giganotosaurus, Carcharodontosaurus, Spinosaurus), stated as a general research consensus about Giganotosaurus alone.
findings.correct: A 2007 study by Therrien and Henderson concluded that the largest theropods, Giganotosaurus among them, had reached the upper size limit for a strictly bipedal animal.

findings.en_sentence: Fossil tracks attributed to Giganotosaurus range from 36 cm to 50 cm in length with paces between 100 cm and 130 cm, and the footprints are three-toed with large, coarse digits and prominent impressions of claws.
findings.es_sentence: Las huellas fósiles atribuidas al Giganotosaurus varían entre 36 y 50 centímetros de longitud, con pasos de 100 a 130 centímetros, y son de tres dedos, con digitos gruesos y grandes, e impresiones prominentes de las uñas.
findings.problem: The attribution is only Calvo's suggestion based on size (ichnotaxon Abelichnus astigarrae), from a higher stratigraphic level than the main fossils.
findings.correct: Fossil tracks that Calvo suggested could belong to Giganotosaurus range from ...

findings.en_sentence: According to a 2016 study by Apesteguía et al., Giganotosaurus belongs to the family Carcharodontosauridae.
findings.es_sentence: Según un estudio de 2016 realizado por Apesteguía y colaboradores, el Giganotosaurus pertenece a la familia Carcharodontosauridae.
findings.problem: Placement in Carcharodontosauridae dates from the 1990s-2000s (Sereno et al. 1996, Coria & Currie 2006) and is uncontroversial; attributing it to a 2016 study implies it is a recent finding.
findings.correct: Giganotosaurus belongs to the family Carcharodontosauridae, as recovered for example in the 2016 analysis by Apesteguía et al.

findings.es_sentence: Contaba con un cuello robusto dotado de una vértebra axial fuerte, y las vértebras cervicales posteriores presentaban cuerpos cortos y aplanados con articulaciones frontales casi hemisféricas.
findings.problem: 'vértebra axial' means a vertebra of the axial skeleton; the specific bone is the axis (second cervical vertebra).
findings.correct: Tenía un cuello fuerte, con un axis robusto, y las vértebras cervicales posteriores presentaban cuerpos cortos y aplanados con articulaciones frontales casi hemisféricas.

findings.es_sentence: Las huellas fósiles atribuidas al Giganotosaurus varían entre 36 y 50 centímetros de longitud, con pasos de 100 a 130 centímetros, y son de tres dedos, con digitos gruesos y grandes, e impresiones prominentes de las uñas.
findings.problem: 'digitos' lacks the accent, and claw impressions are 'garras', not 'uñas'.
findings.correct: ...con dígitos grandes y gruesos e impresiones marcadas de las garras.

findings.es_sentence: El ejemplar holotipo se estima que midió entre 12 y 13 metros de longitud, mientras que otros estudios basados en el mismo esqueleto sugieren un peso de 6,1 a 6,9 toneladas y una altura superior a 4 metros en la cadera.
findings.problem: Dangling subject ('El ejemplar holotipo se estima que midió'), a calque of the English structure.
findings.correct: Se estima que el ejemplar holotipo medía entre 12 y 13 metros de longitud, mientras que...
